holes.invalid: Invalid preview tunnel. Check the name (1-128 characters), the Runner host, the port (1-65535) and the validity period.
holes.changed: This preview tunnel changed. Reload before saving.
holes.revoked: This preview tunnel has been revoked and can no longer be changed.
holes.notActive: Only an active preview tunnel can be checked.
holes.runnerUpgrade: This Runner does not support preview tunnels yet. Upgrade the Runner.
holes.connectionUnsupported: Preview tunnels only work with Runner-connected hosts.
holes.notFound: This preview link does not exist, has expired or has been revoked.
holes.unavailable: The previewed service cannot be reached: the Runner is offline or the local port is not accepting connections.
holes.busy: This preview has too many open connections. Try again shortly.
holes.timeout: The previewed service did not respond in time.
holes.tooLarge: The request body exceeds the 64 MiB preview limit.
holes.automatic: This preview is managed by a pipeline or workflow. It can only be revoked.
holes.reviewClosed: This preview is not waiting for review.
holes.notReady: The local service did not become reachable in time: {detail}
